status: DRAFT for Aadhar's approval (18 Nov 2026). Owner-owned and protected. Used by #20 (drift) and #21 (incidents).

reference.note: Four weeks early in the densest stretch of the data. Confirm with the weekly volume counts before approving.

threshold_notes.intent_psi: Population stability index of the weekly intent mix vs the reference. 0.1 to 0.2 is a moderate shift; above 0.2 is the common 'act on it' line.
threshold_notes.volume: Ratio of the week's conversations to the reference weekly mean, in either direction (2.0 = double or half).
threshold_notes.mean_confidence: Absolute change in the cheap tier's mean confidence.
threshold_notes.escalated_share: Absolute change in the share escalated (3 points on a ~12% base is a large relative move).
threshold_notes.other_share: Absolute change in the share labelled other, the first sign of a new topic.

notes.window_hours: Sliding window in which outage-labelled threads for one brand are counted.
notes.min_burst: Threads in a window needed to open an incident. Chosen for AmazonHelp first; ordinary hourly traffic should never reach it.
notes.baseline_factor: The window's count must also be at least this multiple of the brand's recent per-window rate.
notes.baseline_lookback_hours: How far back the recent rate looks (7 days covers a weekly cycle). Missing history is reported as warm-up, never treated as zero.
notes.label: Detection uses this label only; keyword clustering is a later slice.
